action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.89) with weak seasonality and moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.43). The weighted alternative (a10) scored 2.3x worse, confirming that with only 3 validation windows, fitted weights chase noise rather than signal. The leader's margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, so no further refinement is warranted.
